_comment: Shared source-of-truth for rebate/STC/price facts that change over time, per the site-loop scorecard's Page 0 requirement. Every page that states one of these figures should match this file. Update the figure, asOf date and source together — never one without the others.

federalBatteryRebate.summary: Support for eligible solar battery systems delivered through small-scale technology certificates (STCs). The certificate entitlement depends on usable battery capacity, installation date and the applicable capacity taper.

taper.rangeKwh: greater than 14 and up to 28 inclusive
greater than 28 and up to 50 inclusive

federalBatteryRebate.caveat: The STC count is not a fixed dollar rebate. The dollar value depends on the STC price, assignment arrangement, fees, product eligibility and installation date. Confirm the final amount in the customer quotation.
